prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Then create an incident documentation report. The purpose of this document is to have a concise, factual and complete record of a work related injury or near miss. All relevant information needs to be captured while information is still fresh: what happened, when, where, who was injured, how severe is it and so forth.
   a. It is not mandatory to use this report. However the person conducting the investigation needs to be familiar. We are to accurately document the accident of incident
3. When conducting a WHMIS assessment, an accident, incident comes about, for example; when someone gets exposed an Muescle Spleen Endocrine Disruptor (SMED). This accident or incident report cannot be used for regulatory compliance reporting.
